llm: MATCH (e:Employee {name: 'Петро Бондар'})-[:DIRECT_MANAGER]->(m:Employee) RETURN m.name AS name
MATCH (:Employee {name: 'Андрій Мельник'})-[:HAS_COMPETENCE]->(c:Competence) RETURN c.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (e:Employee) WHERE e.productivityScore < 5 RETURN e.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (e:Employee)-[:DIRECT_MANAGER*]->(:Employee {name: 'Олена Коваль'}) RETURN DISTINCT e.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (e:Employee)-[:OCCUPIES]->(p:Position) RETURN p.name AS position, round(avg(e.productivityScore), 2) AS avg ORDER BY position
MATCH (e:Employee)-[:COMPLETED_COURSE]->(c:Course {name: 'Python Advanced'}) RETURN e.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (ev:LowProductivityEvent)-[:CONCERNS_EMPLOYEE]->(e:Employee) RETURN e.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (e:Employee) WHERE NOT (e)-[:COMPLETED_COURSE]->() RETURN count(e) AS n
MATCH (e:Employee)-[:DIRECT_MANAGER]->(m:Employee) RETURN m.name AS name, count(e) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
MATCH (:Process {id: 'personnelManagement'})-[:HAS_SUB_PROCESS*1..3]->(p:Process) RETURN DISTINCT p.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (e:Employee) WHERE e.productivityScore < 4 DETACH DELETE e
